subject: re-st
title: RE.ST.------TRS.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 216 (WAC-14). RE-ST (restructuralism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; TRS (transition) is the partner. From the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and ALT-ACT (alternative activism). From ALT-ACT: AFI (affinity insight) and INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis). From AFI: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From INFO-AF-B: IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) and INTR (interpretation). From INTR: AFTF (affinity transfer).
